summary: Sealed park car park with marked bays, rugby fields around, no homes.
reasons: Marked bays off the access road
Parkland and sports fields all round

drivers.seclusion: Surrounded by trees, parkland and rugby fields; only the club buildings 30 m or more away, no homes.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed loop road with marked bays; plenty of room to park out of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet park access road; some club traffic near the clubhouse.
drivers.convention: Few cars in the northern bays; club events may bring people at night.

flags: Rugby club nearby may be busy at evenings and weekends
Low ground: about 37 m, no creek within 200 m
Locked mapped gates beside the outline have a way round
sun_shade: Heavy tree shade from the west and north-east; bays partly open.

best_section.where: Northern bays of the sealed car park, north of the rugby clubhouse
